$comment: Cross-language drift alarm for the Tauri LLM transport (M0-T8).
The Rust side (src-tauri/tests/llm_stream_events.rs) asserts every entry of
`events` round-trips through `LlmStreamEvent` back to this exact JSON; the TS
side (src/transport/tauri-fetch.test.ts) feeds the same entries through a fake
invoke and asserts the Response it produces. Change either side and the other
`chunk` payloads are base64 of RAW BYTES, not text: the 4-byte emoji U+1F409 is
deliberately split across the two chunks, because a per-chunk text decode would
replace half of it with U+FFFD.
